491:t_1:8.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We also separated $$ザフト$$ from $$ネオ・ジオン$$. That has cut $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s fighting strength in half.」

491:t_1:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We confirmed Ensign $$リディ$$ is alive, but he pilots a black $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ called $$バンシィ$$ and leads the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives' field unit.」

491:t_1:10.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$クロノ$$ held Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$ hostage to demand our surrender, but we successfully rescued her.」

491:t_1:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Yes... The various $$ガンダム$$s have begun to demonstrate their full capabilities as well.」

491:t_1:13.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But all this power will be meaningless if the world is destroyed.」

491:t_1:14.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The world's destruction... I cannot fathom $$アマルガム$$'s intentions...」

491:t_1:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The answer is probably waiting at our destination.」

491:t_1:16.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If the rendezvous is off $$相模湾$$, that means...」

491:t_1:17.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our final battle with $$アマルガム$$ will probably be at the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$.」

491:t_1:18.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...So the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and the $$クォーター$$ have discovered $$アマルガム$$'s ultimate goal?」

491:t_1:19.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We don't know the details, either. Captain $$テスタロッサ$$'s message only told us of an emergency and where to rendezvous.」

491:t_1:20.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We will have to hear the details after we join them.」

491:t_1:21.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As for the fighting in space, we secured the cooperation of $$ハマーン・カーン$$'s group, which defected from $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

491:t_1:22.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We also separated $$ザフト$$ from $$ネオ・ジオン$$. That has cut $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s fighting strength in half.」

491:t_1:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We confirmed Ensign $$リディ$$ is alive, but he pilots a black $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ called $$バンシィ$$ and leads the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives' field unit.」

491:t_1:24.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$クロノ$$ held Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$ hostage to demand our surrender, but we successfully rescued her.」

491:t_1:26.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Yes... The various $$ガンダム$$s have begun to demonstrate their full capabilities as well.」

491:t_1:27.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But all this power will be meaningless if the world is destroyed.」

491:t_1:28.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The world's destruction... I cannot fathom $$アマルガム$$'s intentions...」

491:t_1:29.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The answer is probably waiting at our destination.」

491:t_1:30.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If the rendezvous is off $$相模湾$$, that means...」

491:t_1:31.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our final battle with $$アマルガム$$ will probably be at the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$.」

491:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Good work, $$ギミー$$, $$ダリー$$... Now, how about some tea before your next sortie? We have cake, too.」

491:t_10:4.en:
$$ギミー$$
「W-what's with you, $$ＡＧ$$...? You're suddenly so nice, it's creepy...」

491:t_10:5.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Oh, I get it. You're giving us special service because we produced $$Ｚチップ$$s, aren't you?」

491:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Correct. Your teamwork in the last battle produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

491:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add them to the team's reserves.」

491:t_10:8.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Hehe... $$ダリー$$ and I make the best team.」

491:t_10:12.en:
$$ダリー$$
「We were originally one person inside our mother's womb, too...」

491:t_10:13.en:
$$ギミー$$
「But I'm glad. Splitting in two meant I got to meet you, $$ダリー$$.」

491:t_10:15.en:
$$ギミー$$
「If you weren't here, I'd be in trouble with no one to cover for me.」

491:t_10:16.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Honestly! You never stop being a handful!」

491:t_10:17.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Do you understand, $$ギミー$$? Now that $$キタン$$ is gone, we have to work hard as $$大グレン団$$'s vanguard.」

491:t_10:18.en:
$$ダリー$$
「And yet you keep saying things like a little kid...」

491:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The more they fight, the closer they are. It is quite heartwarming to watch.」

491:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But that is not the only reason for this service.)

491:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Their presence not only helped $$タケル$$, but also greatly helped us understand the true essence of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.)

491:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I believe this truth will surely answer the question within me...)

491:t_10:29.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$ＡＧ$$! Give me some ice cream!」

491:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, thank you as always. But is it wise to eat that when the briefing is about to start?」

491:t_10:31.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's not for me. It's for $$グーラ$$.」

491:t_10:33.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It seems $$グーラ$$ couldn't forget the taste of the ice cream he had when he spent time with us.」

491:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see... In that case, the toppings are on the house.」

491:t_10:38.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I obtain everything I want. That is my way.」

491:t_10:39.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, $$グーラ$$! You haven't changed at all since you were a prince!」

491:t_10:41.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's learn those things together, $$グーラ$$.」

491:t_10:43.en:
$$勝平$$
「All right! Then leave it to the great $$勝平$$, leader of the $c Boys' Club!」

491:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When did such a group come into being...?!」

491:t_10:45.en:
$$勝平$$
「First, I'll teach you the customs for newcomers.」

491:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Then I, $$ＡＧ$$, shall preside over $$グーラ$$'s initiation ceremony!」

491:t_10:52.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Why not? $$グーラ$$ seems to be enjoying himself.」

491:t_10:53.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that the ceremony is over, let's all have ice cream. It's my treat today.」

491:t_10:54.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then I'll have... all the toppings!」

491:t_10:56.en:
$$グーラ$$
($c... A world I never knew until now...)

491:t_10:57.en:
$$グーラ$$
(Father... I will live alongside $$正太郎$$ and the others... To atone for what I have done, and for the future of the universe...)

491:t_10:58.en:
$$グーラ$$
(And I swear that someday, I will free you from the depths of darkness.)

492:t_000:1.en:
$$凱$$
「All right! Blue skies and blue seas!」

492:t_000:2.en:
$$渓$$
「For a while there, I wasn't sure how things would turn out.」
